name: Nagycsány (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nagycsány (a blue shield with a white bird and ears of grain) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed NAGYCSÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nagycsány arms with wreath and scroll
